data.description: W polskim prawie nadal pozostaje najdotkliwszy kaganiec dla mediów, blogerów, społeczników i zwykłych obywateli zabierających głos w sprawach publicznych.
data.translatedTitle: Dominika Bychawska-Siniarska: Article 212 of the Penal Code must go down in history
data.translatedDescription: Polish law still imposes the most severe muzzle on the media, bloggers, social activists and ordinary citizens speaking out on public matters.

data.title: Kiedy ekwiwalenty dla strażaków OSP korzystają ze zwolnienia z PIT?
data.description: Gminy wypłacają strażakom ratownikom OSP ekwiwalenty pieniężne również za zadania takie, jak integracja społeczności lokalnej czy wspieranie gminy. Czy takie świadczenia podlegają opodatkowaniu PIT?
data.translatedTitle: When are the equivalents for Volunteer Fire Department firefighters eligible for PIT exemption?
data.translatedDescription: Municipalities also pay firefighters and rescuers of the Volunteer Fire Department cash equivalents for tasks such as integrating the local community or supporting the commune. Are such benefits subject to personal income tax?

data.title: „Lasy lecznicze” coraz popularniejsze w Europie. Jeden z nich jest obok Świnoujścia
data.description: Są „zwykłe” lasy, i są też lasy „lecznicze”. Różnica między nimi jest znacząca – przekonują przedstawiciele organizacji Healing Forest, która zajmuje się certyfikowaniem tego typu lasów.
data.translatedTitle: "Healing forests" are becoming more and more popular in Europe. One of them is near Świnoujście
data.translatedDescription: There are "ordinary" forests, and there are also "medicinal" forests. The difference between them is significant, argue representatives of the Healing Forest organization, which certifies this type of forests.

data.title: Język obcy wciąż daje przewagę i szansę na wyższe zarobki
data.description: Pomimo szybkiego rozwoju programów i aplikacji do tłumaczenia na żywo, znajomość języków obcych pozostaje atutem na rynku pracy, docenianym też finansowo.
data.translatedTitle: A foreign language still gives you an advantage and a chance for higher earnings
data.translatedDescription: Despite the rapid development of live translation programs and applications, knowledge of foreign languages ​​remains an asset on the labor market, which is also appreciated financially.

data.title: WIG30 zamiast WIG20? GPW ma duży ból głowy
data.description: Rynek nie daje jednoznacznej odpowiedzi, czy WIG30 byłby lepszy niż WIG20. Maklerzy, analitycy i zarządzający są mocno podzieleni. Wśród inwestorów aktywnych w mediach społecznościowych poparcie dla WIG30 jest wyraźnie większe.
data.translatedTitle: WIG30 instead of WIG20? The WSE has a big headache
data.translatedDescription: The market does not give a clear answer whether WIG30 would be better than WIG20. Brokers, analysts and managers are sharply divided. Among investors active in social media, support for WIG30 is clearly greater.

data.title: Przemysł motoryzacyjny zaczyna się zbroić. Pora na dual-use
data.description: Wolne moce produkcyjne dostawców motoryzacyjnych będą wykorzystywane dla produkcji zbrojeniowej.
data.translatedTitle: The automotive industry is starting to arm itself. It's time for dual-use
data.translatedDescription: Free production capacity of automotive suppliers will be used for arms production.

data.title: Manosfera wkracza do świata designu. Czas na mieszkania w stylu „samca alfa”
data.description: Luksusowe, przestrzenne i niemal puste. Mieszkania w stylu, który przypadłby do gustu internetowym popularyzatorom teorii „nowej męskości”, zyskują spore grono fanów.
data.translatedTitle: Manosphere enters the world of design. Time for "alpha male" style apartments
data.translatedDescription: Luxurious, spacious and almost empty. Apartments in a style that would appeal to Internet popularizers of the "new masculinity" theory are gaining a large group of fans.

data.title: Radny nie straci mandatu za organizację zabawy andrzejkowej - wyrok NSA
data.description: Jednorazowa inicjatywa społeczna polegająca na organizacji imprezy andrzejkowej w świetlicy wiejskiej nie narusza przepisu antykorupcyjnego z ustawy o samorządzie gminnym.
data.translatedTitle: A councilor will not lose his mandate for organizing St. Andrew's Day party - the Supreme Administrative Court's verdict
data.translatedDescription: A one-off social initiative involving the organization of St. Andrew's Day event in a village community center does not violate the anti-corruption provision of the Act on municipal self-government.

data.title: Polsce brakuje 150 km autostrad. Potem zacznie się wielkie poszerzanie
data.description: Polska ma 1950 km autostrad, a do osiągnięcia planowanej długości sieci pozostało ok. 150 km. Ostatnimi dużymi elementami układanki będą przede wszystkim przedłużenie A2 na wschód oraz A50 pod Warszawą. Równolegle rozpoczyna się rozbudowa najbardziej zatłoczonych fragmentów A1, A2 i A4.
data.translatedTitle: Poland lacks 150 km of highways. Then the great expansion will begin
data.translatedDescription: Poland has 1,950 km of motorways, and approximately 150 km remain to achieve the planned network length. The last major pieces of the puzzle will be the extension of the A2 to the east and the A50 near Warsaw. At the same time, the expansion of the most crowded parts of A1, A2 and A4 begins.

data.title: Waszyngton odcina się od kluczowego raportu o Arktyce. „Nie podano uzasadnienia”
data.description: Amerykańska federalna agencja NOAA podjęła decyzję, która zaskoczyła środowisko naukowe. Wsparcie dla kluczowego raportu o stanie klimatu w Arktyce zostało wstrzymane – i to bez podania jakichkolwiek wyjaśnień.
data.translatedTitle: Washington distances itself from a key report on the Arctic. "No justification provided"
data.translatedDescription: The American federal agency NOAA made a decision that surprised the scientific community. Support for a key report on the state of climate in the Arctic has been withheld - without any explanation.

data.title: Marek Kobylański: Kto naprawdę pisze przepisy? Pytania o granicę lobbingu
data.description: Czy lobbing przy tworzeniu prawa może być zbyt nachalny? Oczywiście. Dlatego przypadek uwag ministrów Miłosza Motyki i Katarzyny Pełczyńskiej-Nałęcz do projektu reformy spółdzielni mieszkaniowych powinien zainteresować nie tylko spółdzielców.
data.translatedTitle: Marek Kobylański: Who really writes the recipes? Questions about the limits of lobbying
data.translatedDescription: Can lobbying when creating laws be too intrusive? Of course. Therefore, the case of the comments of ministers Miłosz Motyka and Katarzyna Pełczyńska-Nałęcz on the project of reforming housing cooperatives should be of interest not only to cooperative members.

data.title: Wiceprezes NFOŚiGW: Jako Polacy mamy skłonność do kombinowania
data.description: Bez zmiany sposobu mówienia o odpadach tkwimy w miejscu, w którym jesteśmy, i jako Polacy płacimy dużo więcej, niż powinniśmy płacić – mówi „Rzeczpospolitej" Paweł Augustyn, zastępca prezesa zarządu Narodowego Funduszu Ochrony Środowiska i Gospodarki Wodnej.
data.translatedTitle: Vice-President of the National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management: As Poles, we tend to think things through
data.translatedDescription: Without changing the way we talk about waste, we remain where we are, and as Poles we pay much more than we should, says Paweł Augustyn, deputy president of the management board of the National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management, to "Rzeczpospolita".

ner.entity: National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management
ner.label: ORG

data.title: Coraz więcej sędziów na delegacji w Ministerstwie Sprawiedliwości, a nie na sali rozpraw
data.description: O blisko 10 proc. wzrosła w ostatnim roku liczba sędziów delegowanych do pracy w Ministerstwie Sprawiedliwości. Więcej jest też tych, którzy na delegacji tkwią od ponad 20 lat. Skąd ten wzrost? – Takie są przepisy – tłumaczy resort.
data.translatedTitle: More and more judges are on delegation to the Ministry of Justice, not in the courtroom
data.translatedDescription: By nearly 10 percent the number of judges delegated to work in the Ministry of Justice has increased in the last year. There are also more of those who have been on business trips for over 20 years. Where does this growth come from? – These are the regulations – explains the ministry.

data.title: Niedozwolony lobbing przy ustawie o spółdzielniach. Ministerstwo rozwoju alarmuje
data.description: Dwa resorty zgłosiły miejscami identyczne uwagi do przepisów mających wprowadzić kadencyjność zarządów spółdzielni mieszkaniowych. Ministerstwo rozwoju pisze o podejrzeniu niedozwolonego lobbingu.
data.translatedTitle: Unauthorized lobbying under the Cooperatives Act. The Ministry of Development is sounding the alarm
data.translatedDescription: Two ministries submitted, in some places, identical comments on the regulations intended to introduce a term of office for management boards of housing cooperatives. The Ministry of Development writes about suspicion of unauthorized lobbying.

data.title: Stany Zjednoczone. Imigrant niemile widziany
data.description: Donald Trump nie jest pierwszym amerykańskim przywódcą, który ogranicza imigrację. Jego poprzednicy również podejmowali podobne kroki w okresach zawirowań gospodarczych i społecznych, ale w przeciwieństwie do obecnego prezydenta robili to z udziałem Kongresu.
data.translatedTitle: United States. Immigrant unwelcome
data.translatedDescription: Donald Trump is not the first American leader to restrict immigration. His predecessors also took similar steps during periods of economic and social turmoil, but unlike the current president, they did so with the involvement of Congress.

data.title: Wojna o zboże na Morzu Czarnym. Odwet za odwet
data.description: Po wielotygodniowych, rosyjskich atakach na ukraińskie porty w rejonie Odessy, Ukraińcy uderzyli w rosyjskie terminale zbożowe. Gwałtowne zmniejszenie morskiego eksportu zbóż z tych dwóch krajów odbije się na światowych rynkach.
data.translatedTitle: Grain war in the Black Sea. Retaliation for retaliation
data.translatedDescription: After many weeks of Russian attacks on Ukrainian ports in the Odessa area, the Ukrainians attacked Russian grain terminals. A sharp reduction in seaborne grain exports from these two countries will have an impact on world markets.

data.title: S Kim Čong-unem se navzájem chápeme, prohlásil Trump
data.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump poukázal při tiskovém vystoupení v Bílém domě na své dobré vztahy se severokorejským vůdcem Kim Čong-unem. Podle agentury AFP řekl, že se s vládcem KLDR navzájem chápou.
data.translatedTitle: Kim Jong-un and I understand each other, Trump said
data.translatedDescription: US President Donald Trump pointed to his good relations with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un during a press conference at the White House. According to AFP, he said that he and the ruler of the DPRK understand each other.

data.title: Schillerová bude jednat s ministry kvůli přípravě státního rozpočtu
data.description: Na ministerstvu financí se budou v úterý a ve středu střídat jednotliví ministři. Ministryně financí Alena Schillerová s nimi bude jednat o podobě jejich rozpočtu pro příští rok. Klíčové bude již první jednání s ministrem práce a sociálních věcí Alešem Juchelkou. Koalice se totiž musí dohodnout, kolik přidá důchodcům.
data.translatedTitle: Schillerová will negotiate with the ministers regarding the preparation of the state budget
data.translatedDescription: Individual ministers will rotate at the Ministry of Finance on Tuesday and Wednesday. Minister of Finance Alena Schillerová will discuss with them the form of their budget for next year. The first meeting with the Minister of Labor and Social Affairs, Aleš Juchelka, will be crucial. The coalition must agree on how much to add to pensioners.

data.title: Co kdyby už Pavel nekandidoval? Politologové nastínili možné scénáře
data.description: Přestože zatím vše nasvědčuje tomu, že Petr Pavel bude v příští prezidentské volbě obhajovat svůj mandát, definitivně se zatím hlava státu stále nerozhodla. Portál iDNES.cz se proto s politology zabýval tím, co by se dělo, kdyby Pavel na jaře příštího roku překvapivě oznámil, že už nebude znovu kandidovat.
data.translatedTitle: What if Pavel no longer ran? Political scientists have outlined possible scenarios
data.translatedDescription: Although so far everything indicates that Petr Pavel will defend his mandate in the next presidential election, the head of state has not yet decided definitively. The portal iDNES.cz therefore discussed with political scientists what would happen if Pavel surprisingly announced in the spring of next year that he would not run again.

data.title: ANALÝZA: Kdo uhne dřív. USA teď ostřelují ceny jídla v Íránu, ten na to však má školu
data.description: Za kulisou občasných raketových přestřelek se v Perském zálivu rozjela válka, která je pro Írán mnohem nebezpečnější, protože v ní explodují ceny. Vojenské akce jsou stále řidší, protože teď Američané jdou po íránských peněženkách, zatímco íránským cílem jsou peněženky arabských spojenců Washingtonu.
data.translatedTitle: ANALYSIS: Who will dodge first. The US is now attacking food prices in Iran, but Iran has a school for that
data.translatedDescription: Behind the backdrop of occasional missile fire, a war has broken out in the Persian Gulf, which is far more dangerous for Iran because of exploding prices. Military action is becoming less frequent because now Americans are after Iran's wallets, while Iran's target is the wallets of Washington's Arab allies.

data.title: Kapesné v Česku dostává devět dětí z deseti, častěji už na účet než v hotovosti
data.description: Většina dětí dostává od rodičů pravidelné kapesné. Obvykle jde o pravidelnou měsíční částku do 600 korun. S věkem se peníze od rodičů stále častěji přesouvají z kasičky na účet a do mobilu. Vyplývá to z průzkumů, které provedli zástupci finančního sektoru.
data.translatedTitle: Nine out of ten children in the Czech Republic receive pocket money, more often on account than in cash
data.translatedDescription: Most children receive regular pocket money from their parents. It is usually a regular monthly amount of up to 600 crowns. With age, money from parents is increasingly transferred from the cash register to the account and to the mobile phone. This follows from surveys conducted by representatives of the financial sector.

data.title: Do Moldavska vletěla ruská střela. Kišiněv to označil za vážné porušení suverenity
data.description: Do Moldavska v pondělí vletěla ruská střela s plochou dráhou letu Banderol, oznámilo ukrajinské letectvo. Chvíli předtím varovalo, že střely Banderol letí na Oděskou oblast na jihu země. Moldavská policie poté informovala o výbuchu u vsi Talmaza, který způsobil lesní požár. Moldavské ministerstvo zahraničí podle médií odsoudilo narušení vzdušného prostoru země.
data.translatedTitle: A Russian missile flew into Moldova. Chisinau called it a serious violation of sovereignty
data.translatedDescription: A Russian Banderol cruise missile flew into Moldova on Monday, the Ukrainian Air Force announced. Moments before, it warned that Banderol missiles were flying towards the Odesa region in the south of the country. Moldovan police then reported an explosion near the village of Talmaza that caused a forest fire. According to the media, Moldova's Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the violation of the country's airspace.

data.title: Škody a výpadky elektřiny: silné bouřky řádily v Čechách, doznívaly pak Moravě
data.description: Do Česka po dlouhém období sucha dorazily bouřky, které místy provázel prudký vítr, krupobití i přívalový déšť. Hasiči měli v souvislosti s bouřkou přes 550 výjezdů, zasahovali například u stromů popadaných na silnice i železniční tratě. Několik tisíc domácností ve východních Čechách a na Vysočině se ocitlo bez proudu. Meteorologové konstatovali, že po extrémních vedrech a suchu se počasí v Česku vrací k typičtějšímu letnímu průběhu: teploty budou mírnější a častěji bude pršet.
data.translatedTitle: Damage and power outages: strong storms raged in Bohemia, then subsided in Moravia
data.translatedDescription: Thunderstorms arrived in the Czech Republic after a long period of drought, accompanied in some places by strong wind, hail and torrential rain. Firefighters had over 550 exits in connection with the storm, they intervened, for example, in the case of trees that had fallen onto roads and railway lines. Several thousand households in eastern Bohemia and Vysočina found themselves without electricity. Meteorologists stated that after extreme heat and drought, the weather in the Czech Republic is returning to a more typical summer pattern: temperatures will be milder and it will rain more often.

data.title: Déšť přinesl vláhu, ale nerovnoměrně. Který kraj měl nejvíc a který nejmíň
data.description: Po šílených vedrech a tropických teplotách v pondělí konečně zapršelo na téměř celém území České republiky. I tak na většině území vládne sucho, které jednodenní srážky nevrátí do normálu, napsal ČHMÚ na svém X.
data.translatedTitle: The rain brought moisture, but unevenly. Which region had the most and which had the least
data.translatedDescription: After insane heat and tropical temperatures, it finally rained on almost the entire territory of the Czech Republic on Monday. Even so, there is a drought in most of the territory, which one-day rainfall will not bring back to normal, wrote the ČHMÚ on its X.

data.title: Stát řeší boj zemědělců se suchem. Rozdělí mezi ně miliardy
data.description: Kvůli dopadům sucha obdrží zemědělci mimořádné podpory a úlevy v dotačních podmínkách. Ministerstvo zemědělství v pondělí informovalo o chystaném balíku pomoci zemědělským podnikům. Mezi zemědělce by měl resort z unijního rozpočtu doplněného o národní peníze rozdělit více než 3,8 miliardy korun. Podporu farmáři dostanou během prvního pololetí příštího roku.
data.translatedTitle: The state is dealing with farmers' struggle with drought. He will divide the billions between them
data.translatedDescription: Due to the effects of the drought, farmers will receive extraordinary support and concessions in terms of subsidies. On Monday, the Ministry of Agriculture announced the upcoming aid package for agricultural enterprises. The department should distribute more than 3.8 billion crowns from the Union budget supplemented by national money to farmers. Farmers will receive support during the first half of next year.

data.title: „Zajdeme do kina?“ Babiš vyhlásil soutěž s výherci. Follow na síti mu nabídl i Kupka
data.description: Vskutku kontaktní formu politické kampaně zvolil Andrej Babiš, který na sociální síti Instagram láká své příznivce na soutěž o lístky do kina. Podmínky jsou jednoduché – stačí napsat do komentáře pod příspěvek svůj oblíbený film a také nezapomenout sledovat profil premiéra.
data.translatedTitle: "Shall we go to the cinema?" Babiš announced the competition with the winners. Kupka also offered him a follow on the network
data.translatedDescription: Indeed, Andrej Babiš has chosen a contact form of political campaign, who is inviting his supporters to a competition for cinema tickets on the Instagram social network. The conditions are simple - just write your favorite movie in the comment under the post and don't forget to follow the profile of the prime minister.

data.title: Norský král skončil v nemocnici, povinnosti převzal korunní princ
data.description: Devětaosmdesátiletý norský král Harald V. byl v pondělí hospitalizován a na dva týdny přerušil výkon svých povinností, informuje s odvoláním na královský palác agentura AFP. Zastupovat ho bude korunní princ Haakon.
data.translatedTitle: The King of Norway ended up in hospital, the crown prince took over the duties
data.translatedDescription: The 89-year-old King of Norway, Harald V., was hospitalized on Monday and suspended the performance of his duties for two weeks, AFP reports with reference to the royal palace. He will be represented by Crown Prince Haakon.

data.title: Íránci pohrozili ofenzivou. Vztyčte raději bílou vlajku, vzkázal jim Trump
data.description: Írán se rozhodl přejít z obrany do plné ofenzivy. Mohou za to zablokované snahy o trvalé ukončení války s USA, uvedl v pondělí vysoce postavený íránský zdroj. Americký prezident Donald Trump mezitím v rozhovoru se stanicí Fox News řekl, že Teherán by měl „vztyčit bílou vlajku kapitulace“. Dodal, že USA neusilují o prodloužení červnového memoranda o porozumění s touto zemí.
data.translatedTitle: The Iranians threatened an offensive. Raise the white flag, Trump told them
data.translatedDescription: Iran decided to go from defensive to full offensive. Blocked efforts to permanently end the war with the US are to blame, a senior Iranian source said on Monday. US President Donald Trump, meanwhile, said in an interview with Fox News that Tehran should "raise the white flag of surrender". He added that the US is not seeking to extend the June memorandum of understanding with the country.

data.title: Nové nádrže? Za 30 let. Když nezadržíme vodu, můžeme ji kupovat, varuje expert
data.description: Vláda dnes oznámila obnovení zasedání Koalice pro boj proti suchu a opakovaně zmínila plán začít stavět až 20 nových vodních nádrží. Postavit přehradu ale může trvat až 35 let, jak pro iDNES.cz varuje hydrolog z organizace InterSucho docent Evžen Zeman. Podle něj je ale zadržování vody v krajině pro Českou republiku naprosto klíčové.
data.translatedTitle: New tanks? In 30 years. If we don't retain water, we can buy it, the expert warns
data.translatedDescription: Today, the government announced the resumption of the meeting of the Coalition to fight the drought and repeatedly mentioned the plan to start building up to 20 new water reservoirs. However, it may take up to 35 years to build a dam, as a hydrologist from the InterSucho organization, associate professor Evžen Zeman, warns for iDNES.cz. According to him, water retention in the landscape is absolutely crucial for the Czech Republic.

data.title: Komunální volby 2026: kdy budou a jak se v nich dávají preferenční hlasy
data.description: Češi letos na podzim rozhodnou o novém složení zastupitelstev v celé zemi. Termín voleb je dán zákonem, v pátek 9. a v sobotu 10. října 2026. Komunální volby patří k těm nejsložitějším v Česku. Jak probíhají a kdo jsou kandidáti?
data.translatedTitle: Municipal elections 2026: when they will be and how preferential votes are cast in them
data.translatedDescription: This fall, Czechs will decide on the new composition of local councils across the country. The date of the elections is set by law, on Friday 9 and Saturday 10 October 2026. Municipal elections are among the most complicated in the Czech Republic. How are they going and who are the candidates?

data.title: „Ruský Starlink“ znepokojuje Ukrajinu. Varuje, že je hrozbou i pro Evropu
data.description: Rassvět, ruská odpověď na americký systém satelitního internetu Starlink, vyvolává v Kyjevě znepokojení. Ukrajinci přiznávají, že jej Rusové budují rychleji, než se očekávalo. Ukrajinští představitelé vymýšlejí způsoby, jak se vůči němu postavit, včetně útoků na centra kosmického vývoje. Podle odborníků má Rassvět řadu úskalí, mohl by ale Rusům výrazně pomoci v jejich boji a být nebezpečím i pro Evropu.
data.translatedTitle: "Russian Starlink" worries Ukraine. He warns that he is also a threat to Europe
data.translatedDescription: Rassvet, Russia's answer to America's Starlink satellite internet system, is causing concern in Kyiv. The Ukrainians admit that the Russians are building it faster than expected. Ukrainian officials are devising ways to counter it, including attacks on space development centers. According to experts, Rassvět has a number of pitfalls, but it could significantly help the Russians in their fight and be a danger for Europe as well.

data.title: Koalice chce ve Sněmovně v září jednat o zmrazení platů politiků
data.description: Poslanci budou v září jednat o zmrazení platů politiků do roku 2030. Dohodla se na tom vládní koalice poté, co premiér a předseda ANO Andrej Babiš po jednání vlády na dotaz iDNES.cz odvětil, že chce, aby Sněmovna projednala návrh vládních stran na zmrazení platů politiků.
data.translatedTitle: The coalition wants to discuss freezing politicians' salaries in the House of Representatives in September
data.translatedDescription: In September, MPs will discuss the freezing of politicians' salaries until 2030. The government coalition agreed on this after Prime Minister and ANO chairman Andrej Babiš replied to iDNES.cz's question after the government meeting that he wanted the House of Representatives to discuss the government parties' proposal to freeze politicians' salaries.

data.title: Babiš zadal v koalici pro boj se suchem zmapovat místa, odkud rychle mizí voda
data.description: Po dvoutýdenní letní dovolené se sešla vláda Andreje Babiše. „Řešili jsme hlavně sucho,“ prohlásil premiér. Opatření proti extrémnímu suchu a pro zadržování vody v krajině má chystat Národní koalice pro boj se suchem složená ze zástupců státu a odborníků. V jejím čele je Babiš a sešla se poprvé hned po jednání vlády.
data.translatedTitle: Babiš commissioned the coalition to fight drought to map places where water is rapidly disappearing
data.translatedDescription: After a two-week summer vacation, the government of Andrej Babiš met. "We mainly dealt with the drought," said the prime minister. Measures against extreme drought and water retention in the landscape are to be prepared by the National Coalition for the Fight against Drought, made up of representatives of the state and experts. It is headed by Babiš and met for the first time right after the government meeting.

data.title: Volby do Senátu 2026: kdy jsou, kde se volí a kdo jsou kandidáti
data.description: V senátních volbách se letos vymění třetina z 81 senátorů. Termín je dán zákonem, první kolo proběhne 9. a 10. října 2026. Své nové zástupce Češi zvolí ve 27 obvodech. Jak je to v senátních volbách s voličským průkazem a korespondenční volbou? A kdy se dozvíme jména kandidátů?
data.translatedTitle: Senate elections 2026: when are they, where are the elections and who are the candidates
data.translatedDescription: A third of the 81 senators will be replaced in the senate elections this year. The deadline is set by law, the first round will take place on October 9 and 10, 2026. Czechs will elect their new representatives in 27 districts. How is it in senate elections with a voter's card and a postal vote? And when will we know the names of the candidates?

data.title: Volby 2026: kdy se letos konají komunální volby a kde se volí do Senátu
data.description: Česko letos čekají dvoje volby, oboje na začátku října 2026. Druhý říjnový víkend voliči mohou hlasovat o nové podobě zastupitelstva své obce a ve třetině okrsků také o tom, kdo je bude zastupovat v Senátu. Každé hlasování probíhá trochu jinak.
data.translatedTitle: Elections 2026: when are municipal elections being held this year and where are the Senate elections being held
data.translatedDescription: The Czech Republic is facing two elections this year, both at the beginning of October 2026. On the second weekend of October, voters can vote on the new form of their municipality's council and, in a third of the constituencies, also on who will represent them in the Senate. Each vote is slightly different.

data.title: Končí odpad z oblíbené atrakce na černé skládce? CHKO řeší podezřelé počínání
data.description: Do zámeckého areálu v Chlumu u Třeboně na Jindřichohradecku proudí davy lidí. Láká je letošní novinka – Svět obrů. Málokdo už ovšem ví, že odpadky z jeho provozu končí v jiné části parku, uprostřed Chráněné krajinné oblasti (CHKO) Třeboňsko. Není to první problém majitelů areálu, v minulých letech se řešila potřebná povolení k rekonstrukci zámku a podezřelý úhyn zvířat ve farmaparku.
data.translatedTitle: Does the waste from a popular attraction end up in a black dump? PLA deals with suspicious behavior
data.translatedDescription: Crowds of people flock to the castle complex in Chlum u Třeboň in Jindřichohradecky. They are attracted by this year's novelty - World of Giants. However, few people know that the waste from its operation ends up in another part of the park, in the middle of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area (PLA). This is not the first problem of the owners of the area, in previous years the necessary permits for the reconstruction of the castle and the suspicious death of animals in the farm park were dealt with.

data.title: VIDEO: Čínský robot běhá rychleji než Usain Bolt. Přezdívají mu Superman
data.description: Robota, který by předběhl držitele tří světových atletických rekordů Usaina Bolta, představila čínská technologická společnost Unitree. Tohoto humanoida přímo navrhla tak, aby „překonal lidské limity“. Například ze stoje vyskočí do výšky dvou metrů.
data.translatedTitle: VIDEO: Chinese robot runs faster than Usain Bolt. They call him Superman
data.translatedDescription: A robot that would overtake Usain Bolt, the holder of three world athletic records, was presented by the Chinese technology company Unitree. She directly designed this humanoid to "exceed human limits". For example, he jumps from a standing position to a height of two meters.

data.title: Dreamliner s 287 lidmi při startu přejel dráhu. Poškozený se vrátil do Mnichova
data.description: Let společnosti Vietnam Airlines do Hanoje se krátce po sobotním vzletu musel vrátil na mnichovské letiště kvůli technickým problémům. Přejel totiž dráhu a poškodil si podvozek i ocasní část trupu. Uvedla to letecká společnost i letiště. „Cestující i členové palubního personálu jsou v bezpečí,“ uvedla letecká společnost. Podle experta mohl incident skončit nehodou s velkým počtem obětí.
data.translatedTitle: The Dreamliner with 287 people overshot the runway during takeoff. The victim returned to Munich
data.translatedDescription: A Vietnam Airlines flight to Hanoi had to return to Munich airport shortly after takeoff on Saturday due to technical problems. He ran over the runway and damaged the landing gear and the tail part of the fuselage. Both the airline and the airport said it. "Passengers and cabin crew are safe," the airline said. According to the expert, the incident could have ended in an accident with a large number of victims.

data.title: Airbnb za bytovou krizi v Praze nemůže, tvrdí analýza. Problémem je bytový dluh
data.description: Problematika krátkodobých pronájmů, neboli Airbnb, bývá v souvislosti s pražskou bytovou krizí jednou z nejzmiňovanějších. Podle nové analýzy projektu Pražské bydlení pod lupou by však i úplný zákaz těchto pronájmů odstranil jen 8,6 procenta ze současného bytového deficitu. Za skutečný problém proto garant projektu Jakub Kuneš označuje bytový dluh.
data.translatedTitle: Airbnb is not to blame for the housing crisis in Prague, according to the analysis. Housing debt is the problem
data.translatedDescription: The issue of short-term rentals, or Airbnb, is one of the most mentioned in connection with the Prague housing crisis. However, according to a new analysis of the Prague housing under a magnifying glass project, even a complete ban on these rentals would remove only 8.6 percent of the current housing deficit. That is why project guarantor Jakub Kuneš refers to housing debt as a real problem.

data.title: Auto stojící v říčce na chráněném území zvedlo vlnu nevole, řidiči hrozí jen malá pokuta
data.description: Stovky příspěvků plných převážně kritiky, volání po zpřísnění trestů či nadávek sklidila na sociálních sítích dvojice mužů zachycená v Chráněné krajinné oblasti Jeseníky při tom, jak zastavila s vozem v napůl vyschlém korytě říčky Střední Opavy. Upozornili na ně ochránci přírody. Událostí už se zabývá policie.
data.translatedTitle: A car standing in a river in a protected area raised a wave of resentment, the driver faces only a small fine
data.translatedDescription: A pair of men caught in the Jeseníky Protected Landscape Area when they stopped their car in the half-dried river bed of the Middle Opava received hundreds of posts full of criticism, calls for stricter punishments or abuse on social networks. Conservationists drew attention to them. The police are already dealing with the incident.

data.title: Na světě jsou tři lidé, kteří nepotřebují pas a cestují všude volně. Kdo to je?
data.description: Téměř každý má svůj pas, je to pro mnohé nepostradatelnou položkou během cestování. Přesto na světě je zhruba 75 procent lidí, kteří pas nemají. Ovšem na světě jsou tři osoby, po kterých není pas vyžadován.
data.translatedTitle: There are three people in the world who do not need a passport and travel freely everywhere. who is that
data.translatedDescription: Almost everyone has a passport, it is an indispensable item for many when traveling. Nevertheless, there are roughly 75 percent of people in the world who do not have a passport. But there are three people in the world for whom a passport is not required.

data.title: Nemovitosti v zahraničí: Proč Čechy lákají Španělsko a Dubaj a na co si dát při koupi pozor
data.description: Touha po druhém domově nebo po místě, kam lze pravidelně utíkat před českou zimou, přivádí stále více Čechů na zahraniční realitní trhy. Největší zájem dlouhodobě směřuje do Španělska, rychle však roste také popularita Spojených arabských emirátů, zejména pak Dubaje. „Přestože všechny tyto destinace nabízejí atraktivní příležitosti, liší se nejen právním prostředím, ale i obchodními zvyklostmi. Jejich neznalost může celý proces nákupu zkomplikovat, prodražit nebo dokonce zhatit,“ říká Martin Novák, vedoucí oddělení produktového managementu v Broker Consulting.
data.translatedTitle: Real estate abroad: Why Czechs are attracted to Spain and Dubai and what to look out for when buying
data.translatedDescription: The desire for a second home or for a place where you can regularly escape from the Czech winter brings more and more Czechs to foreign real estate markets. The greatest interest has long been directed towards Spain, but the popularity of the United Arab Emirates, especially Dubai, is also growing rapidly. "Although all these destinations offer attractive opportunities, they differ not only in their legal environment, but also in their business practices. Ignorance of them can complicate, make the entire purchase process more expensive or even ruin it," says Martin Novák, head of the product management department at Broker Consulting.

data.title: Ironmana zvládla i bez ruky. Přijala jsem sama sebe, to je mé vítězství
data.description: Za každým startovním číslem nedělního královéhradeckého závodu Ironman 70.3 se skrývá jedinečný příběh. Když dnes Petra Václavková stojí na startu triatlonu nebo překážkového závodu, působí sebejistě. V cíli rozdává úsměvy, na sociálních sítích motivuje další sportovce a pro mnoho lidí je symbolem odvahy. Přitom přiznává, že ještě před několika lety byla úplně jiným člověkem.
data.translatedTitle: She managed the Ironman even without a hand. I accepted myself, that's my victory
data.translatedDescription: Behind every starting number of Sunday's Ironman 70.3 race in Královéhradek, there is a unique story. Today, when Petra Václavková stands at the start of a triathlon or an obstacle race, she looks confident. He spreads smiles at the finish line, motivates other athletes on social media and is a symbol of courage for many people. At the same time, she admits that she was a completely different person just a few years ago.

data.title: Žádné skryté sledování, hájí „šmírování“ počítačů Vojtěch. Experti zmiňují limity
data.description: Ministerstvo zdravotnictví si objednalo analýzu, jak zaměstnanci využívají služební počítače. Ministr Adam Vojtěch (ANO) tvrdí, že šlo o opatření kvůli kybernetické bezpečnosti. Zaměstnanci ale namítají, že počítače byly pod dohledem i mimo pracovní dobu a že se firma mohla dostat k citlivým osobním datům. Právníci oslovení redakcí iDNES.cz zpochybňují plošný sběr údajů i jejich možné využití k hodnocení pracovníků.
data.translatedTitle: No hidden surveillance, Vojtěch defends "spying" on computers. Experts mention limits
data.translatedDescription: The Ministry of Health commissioned an analysis of how employees use work computers. Minister Adam Vojtěch (ANO) claims that it was a measure due to cyber security. But employees counter that the computers were under surveillance outside of working hours and that the company could have accessed sensitive personal data. Lawyers contacted by the editorial staff of iDNES.cz question the widespread collection of data and its possible use to evaluate employees.

data.title: Dříve byly přehlížené, dnes definují atmosféru koupelny. Nepodceňte význam koupelnových doplňků
data.description: Málokterá součást interiérového designu stoupla na významu tak výrazně, jako koupelnové doplňky. Dříve lidé vybírali jednoduše to nejlevnější a nejdostupnější na trhu. V krásné nově zrekonstruované koupelně jsme pak našli vedle prostorné vany a umyvadla ze sněhově bílé keramiky kelímek na kartáčky z laciného plastu a háčky na ručníky, které vypadaly, že spadnou, jen se na ně někdo ošklivě podívá. To se však změnilo.
data.translatedTitle: Before they were overlooked, today they define the atmosphere of the bathroom. Do not underestimate the importance of bathroom accessories
data.translatedDescription: Few parts of interior design have risen in importance as significantly as bathroom accessories. Previously, people simply chose the cheapest and most available on the market. In the beautiful newly renovated bathroom, next to the spacious bathtub and sink made of snow-white ceramics, we found a cup for toothbrushes made of cheap plastic and hooks for towels that looked like they would fall if someone gave them a nasty look. However, that has changed.

data.title: Zâmbia reelege Hakainde Hichilema como Presidente
data.description: O Presidente cessante da Zâmbia, Hakainde Hichilema, foi reeleito com cerca de 60% dos votos, anunciou hoje a comissão eleitoral do país africano, após um escrutínio realizado na semana passada e marcado pela detenção de opositores.
data.translatedTitle: Zambia re-elects Hakainde Hichilema as President
data.translatedDescription: The outgoing President of Zambia, Hakainde Hichilema, was re-elected with around 60% of the votes, the African country's electoral commission announced today, after a vote held last week and marked by the arrest of opponents.

data.title: Líder da África do Sul pede união regional em cimeira após marcha anti-imigração
data.description: O Presidente da África, Cyril Ramaphosa, pediu aos países da África Austral que se unam perante o "desafio da imigração", após uma manifestação contra os imigrantes, à margem de uma cimeira regional em Durban (leste).
data.translatedTitle: South African leader calls for regional unity at summit after anti-immigration march
data.translatedDescription: The President of Africa, Cyril Ramaphosa, called on Southern African countries to unite in the face of the "immigration challenge", after a demonstration against immigrants, on the sidelines of a regional summit in Durban (east).

data.title: Petróleo detetado na Amazónia é um "passaporte para o futuro"
data.description: O Presidente do Brasil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, qualificou o petróleo recentemente descoberto ao largo da Amazónia como um "passaporte para o futuro", com organizações ambientalistas a contestar a exploração petrolífera na região.
data.translatedTitle: Oil detected in the Amazon is a “passport to the future”
data.translatedDescription: The President of Brazil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, described the recently discovered oil off the Amazon as a "passport to the future", with environmental organizations contesting oil exploration in the region.

data.title: Trump manda calar repórter da CNN que lhe perguntou sobre Coreia do Norte
data.description: O Presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, mandou calar esta segunda-feira, por várias vezes, a correspondente da CNN na Casa Branca, Kristen Holmes, quando a jornalista o questionou sobre contactos recentes com o líder da Coreia do Norte.
data.translatedTitle: Trump silences CNN reporter who asked him about North Korea
data.translatedDescription: The President of the United States, Donald Trump, on Monday silenced CNN's White House correspondent Kristen Holmes several times when the journalist questioned him about recent contacts with the leader of North Korea.

data.title: Instituto de Medicina Legal da Colômbia recebeu 304 corpos de vítimas
data.description: O Instituto de Medicina Legal (IML) da Colômbia recebeu 304 corpos de vítimas do sismo de 10 de agosto, tendo já identificado 300 que foram entregues na sua maioria às famílias, informou esta segunda-feira a entidade.
data.translatedTitle: Colombia's Institute of Forensic Medicine received 304 bodies of victims
data.translatedDescription: Colombia's Institute of Legal Medicine (IML) received 304 bodies of victims of the August 10 earthquake, having already identified 300, most of which were handed over to their families, the entity reported this Monday.

data.title: Dois `designers` iranianos detidos desde 19 de julho após reunião com diplomatas
data.description: Dois `designers` gráficos iranianos encontram-se detidos desde 19 de julho em Teerão, após se terem encontrado com dois diplomatas franceses, afirmam os seus familiares, que pedem a Paris que intervenha para obter a sua libertação.
data.translatedTitle: Two Iranian 'designers' detained since July 19 after meeting with diplomats
data.translatedDescription: Two Iranian graphic designers have been detained since July 19 in Tehran, after meeting with two French diplomats, say their families, who are asking Paris to intervene to obtain their release.

data.title: Riqueza é dos atributos das pessoas que Trump mais aprecia
data.description: A riqueza tem sido o atributo mais apreciado por Donald Trump nas nomeações no seu regresso à Casa Branca, segundo um levantamento feito pela organização Public Citizena.
data.translatedTitle: Wealth is one of the attributes of people that Trump most appreciates
data.translatedDescription: Wealth has been the attribute most appreciated by Donald Trump in nominations upon his return to the White House, according to a survey carried out by the organization Public Citizena.

data.title: ONG alerta para "graves repercussões" de cortes na ajuda a pessoas com deficiência

data.translatedDescription: Non-governmental organization (NGO) Handicap International (HI) has warned of the "devastating consequences" of cuts in international aid to people with disabilities.

data.description: A embaixada da Rússia em Londres avisou que o Reino Unido terá de "responder" pela colaboração militar com a Ucrânia, após informações de que drones britânicos foram utilizados por Kiev para ataques em território russo.

data.translatedDescription: The Russian embassy in London warned that the United Kingdom will have to "respond" for military collaboration with Ukraine, following reports that British drones were used by Kiev for attacks on Russian territory.

data.title: Macron promulga lei que permite investimento de 36.000 ME em defesa
data.description: O Presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, promulgou a lei de programação militar aprovada pelo parlamento, que permitirá um investimento de 36.000 milhões de euros nas Forças Armadas do país até 2030.
data.translatedTitle: Macron promulgates law allowing investment of ME 36,000 in defense
data.translatedDescription: French President Emmanuel Macron promulgated the military programming law approved by parliament, which will allow an investment of 36 billion euros in the country's Armed Forces by 2030.

data.title: Kushner prevê "avanços" no desarmamento de milícias palestinianas num mês
data.description: O enviado especial dos Estados Unidos, Jared Kushner, previu hoje "avanços" na desmilitarização da Faixa de Gaza num prazo de 30 dias, após um encontro com o primeiro-ministro israelita, Benjamin Netanyahu.
data.translatedTitle: Kushner predicts "breakthrough" in disarmament of Palestinian militias within a month
data.translatedDescription: United States special envoy, Jared Kushner, today predicted "progress" in the demilitarization of the Gaza Strip within 30 days, after a meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

data.title: Julgamento de homicida Luigi Mangione nos EUA adiado
data.description: O julgamento no tribunal do Estado de Nova Iorque do jovem norte-americano Luigi Mangione, homicida confesso de um executivo de seguros de saúde, foi adiado na segunda-feira.
data.translatedTitle: Trial of murderer Luigi Mangione in the USA postponed
data.translatedDescription: The trial in New York State court of young American Luigi Mangione, the confessed killer of a health insurance executive, was postponed on Monday.

data.title: Número de vítimas mortais nos terramotos na Venezuela elevado para 6.438
data.description: O balanço de mortes causadas pelo terramoto duplo de 24 de junho, no norte da Venezuela, foi elevado para 6.438, depois de as autoridades terem registado mais 137 vítimas.
data.translatedTitle: Number of fatalities in earthquakes in Venezuela raised to 6,438
data.translatedDescription: The death toll caused by the double earthquake of June 24, in northern Venezuela, was raised to 6,438, after authorities registered another 137 victims.

data.title: Guterres insta Washington e Teerão a retomarem negociações
data.description: O secretário-geral das Nações Unidas, António Guterres, instou os Estados Unidos e o Irão a retomarem negociações para chegar a um acordo "o mais rapidamente possível", após o fim do memorando de entendimento de 60 dias.
data.translatedTitle: Guterres urges Washington and Tehran to resume negotiations
data.translatedDescription: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres urged the United States and Iran to resume negotiations to reach an agreement "as quickly as possible" after the end of the 60-day memorandum of understanding.

data.title: Incêndio obriga a confinamento em Seixo de Manhose, Vila Flor
data.description: Um incêndio que deflagrou às 23:00, obrigou ao confinamento da população na aldeia de Seixo de Manhoso, em Vila Flor, com as chamas a ameaças propriedades e culturas.

data.translatedDescription: A fire that broke out at 11pm forced the population to be confined in the village of Seixo de Manhoso, in Vila Flor, with the flames threatening properties and crops.

data.title: Lula e presidente do Senado reatam diálogo após meses de crise na articulação política
data.description: O Presidente brasileiro, Lula da Silva, e o presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre, trocaram elogios públicos, em sinal de reconciliação, após meses de crise na articulação política.
data.translatedTitle: Lula and Senate president resume dialogue after months of crisis in political articulation
data.translatedDescription: The Brazilian President, Lula da Silva, and the President of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre, exchanged public praise, in a sign of reconciliation, after months of crisis in political articulation.

data.title: Noite complicada em Ponte de Lima

data.translatedDescription: At around 00:00 on Tuesday there was still no need for confinements, but the firefighting forces expected a difficult night.

data.description: Mais de 1.000 operacionais combatiam pelas 23:30 de hoje os quatro principais incêndios ativos em Portugal continental, todos na zona norte, sendo o de Torre de Moncorvo aquele que mobilizava mais meios.
data.translatedTitle: More than 1,000 operators were fighting four major fires at 11 p.m.
data.translatedDescription: At 11:30 pm today, more than 1,000 operators were fighting the four main active fires in mainland Portugal, all in the north, with Torre de Moncorvo being the one that mobilized the most resources.

data.title: EUA intercetaram mais de 60 navios desde reposição de bloqueio a portos iranianos
data.description: As forças norte-americanas travaram um total de 64 embarcações comerciais, inutilizaram três e abordaram outras duas, desde a reposição do bloqueio naval aos portos e à costa iraniana, divulgou hoje o Comando Central militar (Centcom).
data.translatedTitle: US intercepted more than 60 ships since blocking Iranian ports
data.translatedDescription: US forces have stopped a total of 64 commercial vessels, disabled three and boarded two others, since the restoration of the naval blockade of ports and the Iranian coast, the military Central Command (Centcom) announced today.

data.title: Trump prevê que Irão não aceitará acordo "necessário" sobre nuclear
data.description: O Presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, previu hoje que o Irão não aceitará o acordo que pretende sobre o programa nuclear da República Islâmica.
data.translatedTitle: Trump predicts Iran will not accept "necessary" nuclear deal
data.translatedDescription: The President of the United States, Donald Trump, predicted today that Iran will not accept the agreement it seeks on the Islamic Republic's nuclear program.

data.title: Discord atende exigência do Brasil e suspende `lives` após morte de adolescente
data.description: A plataforma Discord suspendeu hoje as funcionalidades de vídeo em tempo real no Brasil, em cumprimento de uma determinação do Governo do país sul-americano, após a morte de uma adolescente de 13 anos.
data.translatedTitle: Discord meets Brazil's demand and suspends 'lives' after death of teenager
data.translatedDescription: The Discord platform today suspended real-time video features in Brazil, in compliance with a government order in the South American country, following the death of a 13-year-old teenager.

data.title: Itália condiciona retoma de Schengen a situação "muito preocupante" de Ceuta
data.description: O ministro dos Negócios Estrangeiros de Itália assegurou hoje que Roma avalia "com grande atenção" a reabertura do espaço Schengen com Espanha e que a decisão dependerá de como evoluir a "muito preocupante" crise migratória em Ceuta.
data.translatedTitle: Italy conditions the resumption of Schengen on the "very worrying" situation in Ceuta
data.translatedDescription: The Italian Foreign Minister assured today that Rome is evaluating "with great care" the reopening of the Schengen area with Spain and that the decision will depend on how the "very worrying" migration crisis in Ceuta evolves.

data.title: Bird flu kills 13,000 seal pups on remote Australian island
data.description:
SYDNEY: A pathogenic strain of bird flu killed more than 13,000 elephant seal pups after infecting a breeding colony on a sub-Antarctic volcanic island, Australian scientists said Thursday.
	Researchers found the remote Heard and McDonald Islands littered with seal carcasses when they arrived on a research expedition in October 2025.
	Genetic testing confirmed the contagious H5 bird flu strain had killed seals, penguins and birds living on the rocky outcrop — the first time it had been detected in one of Australia’s external territories.

data.title: Australia says net migration down as far-right popularity surges
data.description:
SYDNEY: Australia’s immigration levels fell last year, official data showed on Thursday, as its center-left government seeks to combat an ascendent far-right riding a wave of public discontent over soaring housing prices and cost of living.
	Net overseas migration added 301,000 people to Australia’s population of 28 million last year, Canberra’s Bureau of Statistics reported.
	Immigration minister Tony Burke said the figure was down nine percent from a year earlier and 45 percent lower than a post-Covid peak in 2023.

data.title: Oil falls to 3-1/2-month low after US, Iran sign ceasefire deal
data.description:

	Brent crude futures were down $2.14, or 2.69 percent, at $77.41 a barrel as of 09:16 a.m. Saudi time, and US West Texas Intermediate fell $2.36, or 3.07 percent, to $74.43 a barrel.

data.title: Daily Telegraph columnist argues Saudi Arabia should join G7
data.description:
DUBAI: Saudi Arabia should be invited to join the Group of Seven nations as the organization adapts to a changing global order, according to a column published in the Daily Telegraph by former UK prime ministerial representative to Saudi Arabia Ken Costa.

	Costa argued that while the G7 was created in the aftermath of the 1970s oil crisis, the world has changed dramatically since then, with new economic and geopolitical powers emerging. Despite those shifts, he said the group remains largely unchanged and no longer reflects the realities of global influence.

data.title: Économie : la BAD évalue le capital naturel du Cameroun à 222,3 milliards USD
data.description: © DR 222,3 milliards USD. Soit 130 000 milliards FCFA. C’est la valeur du capital naturel du Cameroun estimée par la Banque africaine de développement. Il représente 39 % de la richesse nationale. Mais l’institution alerte : la rente issue de ces ressources est tombée de 6,5 % à 4,7 % du PIB entre 2018 et 2020, et le capital naturel par habitant a chuté de 47,9 % en 25 ans. Le Cameroun est plus riche qu’il n’y paraît. Du moins sur le papier de ses ressources naturelles. La Banque africaine de développement invite le pays à revoir sa méthode de calcul du Produit intérieur brut. L’objectif : intégrer la valeur des forêts, de l’énergie et des minerais pour avoir une image plus fidèle de l’économie. Selon les estimations de la BAD, le capital naturel du Cameroun s’élève à 222,3 milliards de dollars, l’équivalent d’environ 130 000 milliards FCFA. Un poids lourd qui représente 39 % de la richesse nationale globale. Sur 25 ans, ce capital a progressé de 4,5 %, passant de 212 à 222 milliards USD. Mais la BAD relève un recul inquiétant derrière ce chiffre. La contribution des rentes issues du capital naturel au PIB a fondu. Elle est passée de 6,5 % en 2018 à 4,7 % en 2020. Pire encore, rapporté à la population, le capital naturel par habitant s’est effondré de 47,9 % entre 1995 et 2020. Conséquence d’une double pression : la croissance démographique et une exploitation jugée peu durable des forêts et des ressources minières. En 2025, la Banque mondiale allait dans le même sens. Elle situait la richesse naturelle du Cameroun à 331 800 milliards FCFA. Dans son rapport, le capital humain reste la première composante du patrimoine national avec 54 %, devant le capital naturel et le capital produit. Pour la BAD et la Banque mondiale, intégrer ces ressources dans les comptes nationaux n’est pas qu’un exercice comptable. C’est un préalable pour orienter les futurs financements du développement. Un PIB qui reflète la vraie valeur du patrimoine permettrait de mieux planifier, d’attirer des investissements et de piloter des politiques plus durables. Le message est clair : pour valoriser ce qu’il possède, le Cameroun doit d’abord le compter. Cet article Économie : la BAD évalue le capital naturel du Cameroun à 222,3 milliards USD est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Economy: AfDB estimates Cameroon's natural capital at USD 222.3 billion
data.translatedDescription: © DR 222.3 billion USD. Or 130,000 billion FCFA. This is the value of Cameroon’s natural capital estimated by the African Development Bank. It represents 39% of national wealth. But the institution warns: the rent from these resources fell from 6.5% to 4.7% of GDP between 2018 and 2020, and natural capital per capita fell by 47.9% in 25 years. Cameroon is richer than it seems. At least on paper of its natural resources. The African Development Bank invites the country to review its method of calculating gross domestic product. The objective: to integrate the value of forests, energy and minerals to have a more faithful image of the economy. According to ADB estimates, Cameroon's natural capital amounts to 222.3 billion dollars, the equivalent of approximately 130,000 billion FCFA. A heavyweight which represents 39% of overall national wealth. Over 25 years, this capital has increased by 4.5%, going from 212 to 222 billion USD. But the ADB notes a worrying decline behind this figure. The contribution of rents from natural capital to GDP has melted. It went from 6.5% in 2018 to 4.7% in 2020. Worse still, compared to the population, natural capital per inhabitant collapsed by 47.9% between 1995 and 2020. Consequence of a double pressure: demographic growth and an exploitation considered unsustainable of forests and mining resources. In 2025, the World Bank was moving in the same direction. It placed Cameroon's natural wealth at 331,800 billion FCFA. In its report, human capital remains the leading component of national heritage with 54%, ahead of natural capital and produced capital. For the ADB and the World Bank, integrating these resources into national accounts is not just an accounting exercise. This is a prerequisite for guiding future development financing. A GDP that reflects the true value of heritage would make it possible to plan better, attract investments and drive more sustainable policies. The message is clear: to value what it has, Cameroon must first count it. data.title: Cameroun : la Sonatrel déploie sept transformateurs pour booster le réseau national
data.description: © DR Sept transformateurs de puissance réceptionnés. 335 MVA de capacités additionnelles. Arrivés à Douala, ces équipements seront déployés à Logbaba, Kribi, Bekoko et PROMETAL. Un 7e appareil de 50 MVA sera gardé en réserve. Objectif pour la SONATREL : renforcer le réseau, restaurer des marges et accompagner la croissance de la demande au Cameroun. Le réseau public de transport d’électricité entre dans une nouvelle phase. La SONATREL vient de réceptionner sept transformateurs de puissance dans le cadre d’une opération d’envergure. Ces équipements stratégiques doivent être installés sur plusieurs points clés du Réseau Interconnecté Sud. Une réponse directe aux besoins croissants en électricité liés à l’industrialisation et à l’urbanisation. Logbaba, le cœur du réseau Le poste de Logbaba reçoit le plus gros lot : 3 transformateurs de 60 MVA chacun. Avec une capacité installée actuelle de 385 MVA, Logbaba est déjà une infrastructure majeure. L’arrivée de ces 180 MVA supplémentaires va accroître ses capacités et sécuriser l’alimentation de Douala et ses environs. Kribi et Bekoko en renfort Direction Kribi. La ville portuaire et industrielle obtient un transformateur de 50 MVA pour accompagner sa forte dynamique économique. À Bekoko, c’est aussi d'un transformateur de 50 MVA qui est prévu. Indispensable. Le poste avait vu sa capacité chuter à 36 MVA après un incident majeur survenu lors de la visite du Pape au Cameroun. Ce nouvel équipement doit permettre de restaurer des marges de manœuvre critiques. Le site de PROMETAL n’est pas oublié. L’industriel bénéficie exclusivement d’un transformateur de 75 MVA. Un appui direct pour soutenir la production et le développement des activités. Enfin, le septième transformateur de 50 MVA ne sera pas installé immédiatement. La SONATREL le conserve en réserve stratégique. L’idée est de pouvoir réagir rapidement en cas de panne ou de besoin urgent de remplacement. Au total, c’est une stratégie en trois volets : renforcer les postes existants, accompagner l’industrie et se doter d’une capacité de réaction. Pour la SONATREL, cet investissement va au-delà du matériel. Il s’agit de donner au système électrique camerounais les moyens de suivre la croissance de la demande et de réduire les risques de délestage. Avec ces sept transformateurs, le pays se dote d’un réseau un peu plus robuste. De quoi tenir la charge des prochaines années. Cet article Cameroun : la Sonatrel déploie sept transformateurs pour booster le réseau national est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .

data.title: Fraude pétrolière : 928 litres de gasoil saisis à Yaoundé
data.description: © DR 928 litres de gasoil saisis. 5 quartiers ciblés à Yaoundé et ses environs. Dans la nuit du 13 au 14 août 2026, la Brigade nationale de lutte contre la fraude du MINEE a frappé fort à Nkoabang, Ekounou, Ekoumdoum, Van, Nsam et Awae. L’objectif : assécher les circuits de vente illicite et sécuriser la chaîne de distribution des produits pétroliers. La traque continue. Le Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Énergie ne lâche rien face à la fraude dans le secteur pétrolier. Dans la nuit du 13 au 14 août 2026, la Brigade nationale de lutte contre la fraude des produits pétroliers du MINEE, appuyée par les Forces de maintien de l’ordre, a mené une vaste opération de contrôle dans la capitale et ses alentours. Les équipes ont sillonné Nkoabang, Ekounou, Ekoumdoum, Van et Nsam. Direction également Awae, localité identifiée comme un corridor stratégique pour le transport clandestin des produits pétroliers. Sur le terrain, le constat est tenace : malgré les descentes régulières, plusieurs sites de vente illicite restent actifs. Bidons, fûts et cuves improvisées continuent d’alimenter un marché parallèle qui concurrence directement les stations-service agréées. Bilan de l’opération : 928 litres de gasoil saisis. Une saisie qui envoie un message clair aux fraudeurs. Les contrôles se durcissent et la surveillance des circuits d’approvisionnement et de distribution s’intensifie. Pour le MINEE, l’enjeu dépasse la simple saisie. Il s’agit de préserver l’intégrité de la chaîne de distribution et de garantir que les produits pétroliers arrivent à destination dans le respect de la réglementation. Le gasoil frauduleux, souvent stocké dans des conditions dangereuses, fait courir des risques aux populations et fait perdre d’importantes recettes à l’État. Il fausse aussi la concurrence pour les distributeurs qui respectent les normes. « Nous allons continuer », fait-on savoir au Ministère. L’opération de Yaoundé n’est qu’une étape. D’autres contrôles sont prévus dans les régions, avec pour objectif de faire reculer durablement la fraude dans un secteur stratégique pour l’économie nationale. Le signal est donc donné : le pétrole qui circule en dehors des circuits officiels sera traqué, saisi et les auteurs répondront de leurs actes. Cet article Fraude pétrolière : 928 litres de gasoil saisis à Yaoundé est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Oil fraud: 928 liters of diesel seized in Yaoundé
data.translatedDescription: © DR 928 liters of diesel seized. 5 targeted neighborhoods in Yaoundé and its surroundings. On the night of August 13 to 14, 2026, the MINEE National Anti-Fraud Brigade struck hard in Nkoabang, Ekounou, Ekoumdoum, Van, Nsam and Awae. The objective: to dry up illicit sales channels and secure the distribution chain of petroleum products. The hunt continues. The Ministry of Water and Energy is not giving up in the face of fraud in the oil sector. On the night of August 13 to 14, 2026, the National Petroleum Product Fraud Brigade of the MINEE, supported by the Law Enforcement Forces, carried out a vast control operation in the capital and its surroundings. The teams traveled through Nkoabang, Ekounou, Ekoumdoum, Van and Nsam. Also head to Awae, a locality identified as a strategic corridor for the clandestine transport of petroleum products. On the ground, the observation is persistent: despite regular raids, several illicit sales sites remain active. Cans, barrels and improvised tanks continue to supply a parallel market which competes directly with approved service stations. Results of the operation: 928 liters of diesel seized. A seizure that sends a clear message to fraudsters. Controls are tightening and surveillance of supply and distribution circuits is intensifying. For the MINEE, the issue goes beyond simple seizure. This involves preserving the integrity of the distribution chain and ensuring that petroleum products arrive at their destination in compliance with regulations. Fraudulent diesel, often stored in dangerous conditions, puts populations at risk and causes the State to lose significant revenue. It also distorts competition for distributors who respect the standards. “We will continue,” the Ministry was told. The Yaoundé operation is only one stage. Other controls are planned in the regions, with the aim of sustainably reducing fraud in a strategic sector for the national economy. The signal is therefore given: oil circulating outside official circuits will be tracked, seized and the perpetrators will be held accountable for their actions. data.title: Cameroun : Maroua s’apprête à accueillir la 40e édition de la journée mondiale de l’habitat
data.description: © DR A quelques semaines de la célébration, plusieurs acteurs prennent des dispositions sous l'impulsion du ministère de l'Habitat et de Développement urbain pour que la prochaine édition soit une réussite collective. Du 28 septembre au 05 octobre 2026, la ville de Maroua, capitale régionale de l'Extrême-Nord, abrite les festivités marquant la 40e édition de la journée mondiale de l'habitat. Placée sous le thème : « Un logement adéquat pour tous », l'édition 2026 s'articule autour des échanges sur l'habitat et le développement urbain. Les activités liées à cette célébration intègrent l'aménagement du village de l'habitat, les concours villes propres, la meilleure idée urbaine et architecture, sans oublier les tables rondes et des sessions thématiques. Les réflexions et échanges scientifiques, des actions de sensibilisation, de valorisation des villes, des expositions et initiatives locales vont aussi meubler la semaine d'activités. À travers cette édition qui vient après celle de 2025 célébrée à Bafoussam, le ministère de l'Habitat et du Développement urbain poursuit une ambition. Celle de faire de cette journée un espace où les idées, les politiques publiques, les innovations et les citoyens se rencontrent pour imaginer les villes camerounaises de demain, peut-on lire dans le bulletin d'information hebdomadaire du ministère. D'après la même source, ladite célébration met en lumière les politiques publiques, les projets, les innovations et les bonnes pratiques contribuant à améliorer l'habitat et le cadre de vie des populations. En prélude à cette célébration les autorités de la région et une délégation du ministère de l'Habitat dépêchée dans la région ont déjà échangé sur les bases d'une organisation réussie de cet événement. Alors que chaque acteur connait déjà son rôle, des sites ont été identifiés pour accueillir des festivités. La marche inaugurale se déroulera sur le boulevard Paul Biya. Les autres manifestations auront lieu à la salle polyvalente, et sur le site de la fantasia. Instituée par l'Assemblée générale des Nations Unies en 1985, la journée mondiale de l'habitat est célébrée chaque premier lundi du mois d'octobre. Portée au Cameroun par le ministère de l'Habitat et de Développement urbain, son organisation mobilise les collectivités territoriales, les partenaires au développement, le secteur privé, les universités, la société civile. Cet article Cameroun : Maroua s’apprête à accueillir la 40e édition de la journée mondiale de l’habitat est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Cameroon: Maroua prepares to host the 40th edition of World Habitat Day
data.translatedDescription: © DR A few weeks before the celebration, several actors are taking steps under the leadership of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Development to ensure that the next edition is a collective success. From September 28 to October 5, 2026, the city of Maroua, regional capital of the Far North, hosts the festivities marking the 40th edition of World Habitat Day. Placed under the theme: “Adequate housing for all”, the 2026 edition is structured around discussions on housing and urban development. The activities linked to this celebration include the development of the housing village, clean city competitions, the best urban idea and architecture, without forgetting round tables and thematic sessions. Scientific reflections and exchanges, awareness-raising actions, city promotion, exhibitions and local initiatives will also fill the week with activities. Through this edition which comes after that of 2025 celebrated in Bafoussam, the Ministry of Housing and Urban Development is pursuing an ambition. That of making this day a space where ideas, public policies, innovations and citizens meet to imagine the Cameroonian cities of tomorrow, we can read in the ministry's weekly newsletter. According to the same source, the said celebration highlights public policies, projects, innovations and good practices contributing to improving the habitat and living environment of populations. As a prelude to this celebration, the regional authorities and a delegation from the Ministry of Housing dispatched to the region have already discussed the basis for a successful organization of this event. While each actor already knows their role, sites have been identified to host the festivities. The inaugural march will take place on Boulevard Paul Biya. The other events will take place in the multipurpose room, and on the fantasia site. Established by the United Nations General Assembly in 1985, World Habitat Day is celebrated every first Monday of October. Supported in Cameroon by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Development, its organization mobilizes local authorities, development partners, the private sector, universities and civil society. data.title: Handicap : le CONRHA mobilisé sur la loi de finances 2026 pour une société plus inclusive
data.description: © DR Les 12 et 13 août 2026, au Centre Jean XXIII de Mvolyé, le CONRHA a tenu sa session nationale ordinaire sous la présidence de Mme Pauline Irène NGUENE, ministre des Affaires sociales sous le thème : « Loi de Finances 2026 : Innovations pour une société plus inclusive ». Objectif : outiller les acteurs pour une réinsertion socio-économique effective des personnes handicapées. Placer le handicap au cœur du budget de l’État. C’est l’ambition affichée par le Comité national pour la réadaptation et la réinsertion socioéconomique des personnes handicapées, (CONRHA). Pendant deux jours, les 12 et 13 août 2026, les membres statutaires du Comité et plusieurs invités se sont réunis au Centre Jean XXIII à Mvolyé pour la session nationale ordinaire 2026. Les travaux étaient présidés par Mme Pauline Irène NGUENE, Ministre des Affaires Sociales. Le thème retenu cette année : « Loi de Finances 2026 : Innovations pour une société plus inclusive ». L’objectif était clair : renforcer les capacités des participants sur les nouvelles dispositions budgétaires afin qu’elles se traduisent concrètement en opportunités pour les personnes handicapées. Subventions, exonérations fiscales, financements de projets, accès aux marchés publics... toutes les mesures susceptibles de favoriser l’autonomisation ont été passées au crible. Pour la Ministre, il ne s’agit plus seulement de protection sociale, mais de participation économique. « Nous devons faire en sorte que la loi de finances devienne un véritable levier de réinsertion », a-t-elle souligné. Le CONRHA, placé sous la tutelle du MINAS, a pour mission de coordonner et d’évaluer la politique gouvernementale en matière de réadaptation et de réinsertion. Cette session 2026 intervient dans un contexte où l’État multiplie les signaux pour une société plus équitable. Les échanges ont porté sur trois axes : l’accès à la formation professionnelle, le financement des AGR et des PME portées par des personnes handicapées, et l’amélioration de l’accessibilité dans les services publics. À l’issue des travaux, les participants sont repartis avec des recommandations concrètes. Il s’agit notamment de vulgariser les innovations de la Loi de Finances 2026 auprès des associations, de renforcer le suivi des bénéficiaires et de nouer des partenariats avec le secteur privé. En misant sur l’inclusion budgétaire, le Cameroun réaffirme sa volonté de ne laisser personne de côté. Pour le CONRHA, 2026 doit être l’année où les textes se transforment en emplois, en revenus et en dignité pour les personnes handicapées. Cet article Handicap : le CONRHA mobilisé sur la loi de finances 2026 pour une société plus inclusive est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .

data.title: Cameroun : le gouvernement publie le calendrier de l’année scolaire 2026/2027
data.description: © DR Un arrêté conjoint du ministre de l’Éducation de base, Laurent Serge Etoundi Ngoa et du ministre des Enseignements secondaires Pauline Nalova Lyonga fixe les grandes lignes du déroulement de la prochaine année scolaire. Dans trois semaines, les élèves de la maternelle, du primaire et du secondaire prennent ou reprennent le chemin de l'école. Le 07 septembre 2026 est en effet la date de la rentrée pour les élèves. Tandis que le 30 juillet 2027 marquera la fin de l'année scolaire. L'arrêté conjoint rendu public le 14 août 2026 fixe aussi le découpage de l'année scolaire et la divise en trois trimestres avec deux périodes d'interruption de classes. La première période d'interruption, correspondant aux congés de Noël va du vendredi 18 décembre 2026 à 15h30 au lundi 04 janvier 2027 à 7h30. La seconde période d'interruption quant à elle, correspondant aux congés de Pâques commence le jeudi 25 mars 2027 à 15h30 et s'achève le lundi 12 avril 2027 à 7h30. Le premier trimestre qui commence le 7 septembre s'achève le 27 novembre. Le deuxième trimestre comprend deux parties. La première partie débute le 30 novembre et connait une suspension le 18 décembre avant de reprendre le 04 janvier pour s'achever le 05 mars 2027. Le troisième trimestre comprenant aussi deux parties, démarre le 08 mars et connait une suspension le 25 mars 2027 avant de reprendre le 12 avril pour s'achever le 11 juin 2027. D'après l'arrêté conjoint, les épreuves zéro ou les examens blancs pour l'enseignement primaire se dérouleront les mercredi 14, jeudi 15, vendredi 16 et samedi 17 avril 2026. Les épreuves pratiques d'EPS aux examens officiels se dérouleront du lundi 26 avril au vendredi 07 mai 2027. Les jeux Fenasco ligues A et B auront lieu au cours des congés dits de Pâques. Le même texte indique les périodes de déroulement des examens officiels et concours. Ceux de l'éducation de base auront lieu entre le lundi 10 mai et le vendredi 30 juillet 2027. Et ceux des enseignements secondaires se dérouleront du lundi 19 avril au vendredi 30 juillet 2027. Au cours de l’année scolaires, les activités pédagogiques se feront en présentiel dans des salles de classe et à distance via internet, la radio, la télévision ou par livret d’apprentissage autodidacte. Dans le cadre de l'innovation pédagogique et de la transformation numérique, le gouvernement invite les établissements scolaires à promouvoir l'intégration des ressources numériques éducatives et des outils d'intelligence artificielles dans les activités d'enseignement, d'apprentissage et de remédiation pédagogique. Cet article Cameroun : le gouvernement publie le calendrier de l’année scolaire 2026/2027 est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Cameroon: the government publishes the calendar for the 2026/2027 school year
data.translatedDescription: © DR A joint decree from the Minister of Basic Education, Laurent Serge Etoundi Ngoa and the Minister of Secondary Education Pauline Nalova Lyonga sets the broad outlines for the progress of the next school year. In three weeks, kindergarten, primary and secondary students will go or return to school. September 7, 2026 is in fact the start date for students. While July 30, 2027 will mark the end of the school year. The joint decree made public on August 14, 2026 also sets the division of the school year and divides it into three quarters with two periods of class interruption. The first interruption period, corresponding to the Christmas holidays, runs from Friday December 18, 2026 at 3:30 p.m. to Monday January 4, 2027 at 7:30 a.m. The second period of interruption, corresponding to the Easter holidays, begins on Thursday March 25, 2027 at 3:30 p.m. and ends on Monday April 12, 2027 at 7:30 a.m. The first term which begins on September 7 ends on November 27. The second trimester has two parts. The first part begins on November 30 and is suspended on December 18 before resuming on January 4 to end on March 5, 2027. The third quarter, also comprising two parts, starts on March 8 and is suspended on March 25, 2027 before resuming on April 12 to end on June 11, 2027. According to the joint decree, the zero tests or mock exams for primary education are will take place on Wednesday 14, Thursday 15, Friday 16 and Saturday 17 April 2026. The practical PE tests for the official exams will take place from Monday 26 April to Friday 07 May 2027. The Fenasco league A and B games will take place during the so-called Easter holidays. The same text indicates the periods during which official exams and competitions take place. Those in basic education will take place between Monday May 10 and Friday July 30, 2027. And those in secondary education will take place from Monday April 19 to Friday July 30, 2027. During the school year, educational activities will be carried out face-to-face in classrooms and remotely via the internet, radio, television or by self-taught learning booklet. As part of educational innovation and digital transformation, the government invites educational establishments to promote the integration of digital educational resources and artificial intelligence tools in teaching, learning and educational remediation activities. data.title: Cameroun : Gérard Emmanuel Ondo Ndong décède après 20 ans de prison
data.description: © DR Six mois après sa libération de prison, l'ancien directeur général du Fonds spécial d'équipement et d'intervention intercommunal (FEICOM) meurt. De longues années de prison bouclent son séjour sur terre. Une affaire de détournement de 36 milliards de francs CFA l'envoie derrière les barreaux suite à son arrestation en février 2006 dans le cadre de l'opération épervier. Après 20 ans de détention et six mois de liberté, l'ancien directeur général du Feicom s'en va au moment où il respire l'air de liberté avec action de grâce au Seigneur et gratitude à l'endroit du président de la République. Des années de procès marquent le parcours de l'homme avec un feuilleton judiciaire à plusieurs épisodes. Condamné en instance à 50 ans de prison, la peine sera réduite en appel à 20 ans avant d'être relevée à 30 ans à la Cour suprême. Libéré le 21 février 2026, il aura purgé sa peine. Content d'avoir su faire face à cette épreuve après son sortie de prison, il se réjouissait aussi d'avoir retrouvé tous les membres de sa famille excepté sa mère décédée alors qu'il était en détention. Au moment où Emmanuel Gérard Ondo Ndong sort de la prison, son corps présente des signes de faiblesse. La fatigue découlant de maladies successives prises en charge au cours de la détention, indiquent des effets de celle-ci sur la personne. Outre le corps alors sous l'influence, le patrimoine de l'homme a été saisi. La Société de recouvrement de créances a vendu ses biens meubles et immeubles aux enchères pour restituer à l'Etat des fonds détournés. Cette descente aux enfers commence lorsqu'il est relevé de ses fonctions de directeur général du Feicom le 11 novembre 2005, une année avant son arrestation. Ces dernières années de sa vie, cachent dans cette affaire, le parcours d'un homme dont on parlerait aujourd'hui avec reconnaissance n'eut été l'opération épervier. Cet article Cameroun : Gérard Emmanuel Ondo Ndong décède après 20 ans de prison est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
